title: Penetration Tester
description: Perform ethical hacking, exploit vulnerabilities, conduct simulated cyberattacks, and deliver actionable remediation reports to secure enterprise systems.

goal.objective: Safely emulate real-world cyberattacks against web apps, APIs, and enterprise networks to discover and patch security flaws before malicious hackers exploit them.

learn.summary: Master Burp Suite, Kali Linux tools, OWASP Top 10 (SQLi, XSS, SSRF, IDOR), network enumeration (Nmap), Metasploit, privilege escalation, and executive reporting.
key_competencies: Web App Pentesting with Burp Suite Professional
prerequisites: Deep web architecture knowledge (HTTP, Cookies, Sessions)

capstone_projects.title: Comprehensive Web & API Penetration Testing Portfolio
capstone_projects.description: Complete a full black-box and grey-box security assessment of a vulnerable application, documenting reproduction steps and remediation advice.

interview_focus: How to Exploit and Prevent SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery)
SQL Injection (In-Band vs Blind vs Time-Based)
Privilege Escalation Techniques in Linux (SUID, Sudo Misconfigurations)
Explaining Technical Vulnerabilities to Non-Technical Executives

tree.name: Foundational Cybersecurity & Pentesting Basics
tree.description: Master the absolute core concepts of cybersecurity, networking, operating systems, and scripting. Understand ethical hacking principles, methodologies, and legal boundaries, forming the bedrock for advanced penetration testing.

resources.title: Python for Everybody Specialization (Coursera/University of Michigan)
Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Core Cybersecurity Concepts
children.description: Grasp fundamental cybersecurity principles: CIA triad, risk management, threat modeling, common attack types (malware, phishing), defense in depth. Understand different security roles and basic security controls.

children.name: Networking & OS Internals
children.description: Deep dive into TCP/IP stack, OSI model, common network protocols (HTTP, DNS, SSH, SMB, FTP, SMTP, ICMP) and their vulnerabilities. Gain advanced proficiency in Linux command line, file systems, permissions, processes, and service management. Understand Windows architecture, Active Directory (users, groups, GPOs, trusts), NTFS permissions, and common services.

children.name: Scripting & Automation for Security
children.description: Learn Bash for shell automation, reconnaissance scripting, and task orchestration. Master Python for network programming, data parsing, developing custom tools, interacting with APIs, and automating exploitation routines. Explore basic PowerShell for Windows automation.

resources.title: Black Hat Python: Python Programming for Hackers and Pentesters

children.name: Web & API Technology Fundamentals
children.description: Understand the fundamental architecture of web applications: HTTP/HTTPS protocols, request/response cycles, common web servers (Apache, Nginx, IIS), databases (SQL, NoSQL basics), client-side vs. server-side processing, and the basics of RESTful APIs, JSON, and XML.

resources.title: How the Internet Works: A Practical Guide
Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Ethical Hacking Methodologies & Ethics
children.description: Learn the standardized phases of penetration testing (reconnaissance, scanning, enumeration, vulnerability analysis, exploitation, post-exploitation, reporting, remediation). Understand rules of engagement, legal considerations (e.g., local laws, GDPR, HIPAA), responsible disclosure, and ethical conduct. Familiarize yourself with industry standards like PTES, OWASP, NIST SP 800-115.

resources.title: NIST SP 800-115: Technical Guide to Information Security Testing and Assessment

children.name: Setting Up Your Hacking Lab & Basic Tools
children.description: Set up virtualized environments (VMware Workstation/Player, VirtualBox, KVM) with attacker machines (Kali Linux, Parrot OS) and deliberately vulnerable targets (Metasploitable, OWASP Juice Shop, VulnHub VMs). Learn to use fundamental tools like Wireshark for network analysis, Nmap for basic to advanced scanning, Netcat for network debugging, and basic Metasploit console usage.

resources.title: Wireshark 101: Essential Skills for Network Analysis

tree.name: Web Application Penetration Testing
tree.description: Specialize in identifying, exploiting, and mitigating vulnerabilities in modern web applications, covering common attack vectors, advanced techniques, and API security. This module emphasizes practical, hands-on testing.

children.name: OWASP Top 10 & Common Web Vulnerabilities
children.description: Understand the most critical web application security risks as defined by OWASP Top 10. Learn about common vulnerability types (e.g., Injection, Broken Authentication, XSS, CSRF, Security Misconfiguration, Insecure Deserialization), their impact, and basic exploitation techniques.

resources.title: Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Web Application Testing Proxies & Tools
children.description: Master Burp Suite (Proxy, Repeater, Intruder, Scanner, Sequencer, Comparer, Extender with BApp Store usage), OWASP ZAP, and browser developer tools for intercepting, modifying, and analyzing web traffic. Learn to use command-line tools like Curl and Wget for web interaction.

resources.title: PortSwigger Web Security Academy (Burp Suite Tutorials)

children.name: Advanced Injection Attacks (SQLi, Command, NoSQLi, LDAPi, XPathi)
children.description: Learn to identify and exploit various injection flaws: SQL Injection (Error-based, Union-based, Blind, Time-based), Command Injection, NoSQL Injection, LDAP Injection, and XPath Injection vulnerabilities to gain unauthorized access to databases, execute arbitrary commands, or manipulate application logic.

children.name: Broken Authentication, Session Management & Access Control Bypass
children.description: Discover weaknesses in authentication mechanisms (password attacks, session fixation, JWT misconfigurations, multi-factor bypasses) and horizontal/vertical privilege escalation through Broken Access Control (IDOR, BOLA/BFLA, insecure direct object references, misconfigured roles, path traversal).

children.name: Cross-Site Attacks (XSS, CSRF, Clickjacking)
children.description: Identify and exploit Reflected, Stored, and DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities. Understand and protect against Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks, and learn how to bypass common mitigations. Explore Clickjacking techniques and defenses.

resources.title: Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) & Insecure Deserialization
children.description: Explore Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) to target internal networks, access cloud metadata services, and bypass firewalls. Understand insecure deserialization vulnerabilities across different languages (Java, .NET, Python, PHP) and their exploitation techniques for remote code execution.

children.name: REST, SOAP & GraphQL API Penetration Testing
children.description: Test REST, SOAP, and GraphQL APIs for common vulnerabilities including broken object-level authorization (BOLA), mass assignment, excessive data exposure, rate limiting issues, injection flaws, and authentication weaknesses. Familiarize with OWASP API Security Top 10 and use tools like Postman, curl, and specialized Burp extensions.

children.name: Advanced Client-Side & Server-Side Web Attacks
children.description: Dive into advanced client-side attacks (DOM Clobbering, Prototype Pollution, WebSockets vulnerabilities, Post-Message exploits), Content Security Policy (CSP) bypasses, CORS misconfigurations, Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI), XML External Entity (XXE) attacks, and Single Sign-On (SSO)/OAuth related flaws.

resources.title: Web Security: A Guide to Hacking and Defense

children.name: Practical Project: Web Application Assessment
children.description: Conduct a full, end-to-end penetration test on a complex, deliberately vulnerable web application (e.g., OWASP Juice Shop, BWAAPP, DVWA). Identify, exploit, and document multiple vulnerability types, culminating in a detailed technical report suitable for client delivery.

resources.title: Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

tree.name: Network & Infrastructure Penetration Testing
tree.description: Develop skills to assess the security of external and internal network infrastructure, server systems, and Active Directory environments. Learn to identify vulnerabilities, gain initial access, and escalate privileges effectively.

resources.title: The Hacker Playbook 3: Practical Guide To Penetration Testing

children.name: Infrastructure Reconnaissance & Information Gathering
children.description: Perform extensive passive reconnaissance using OSINT tools (Shodan, Censys, Maltego, Whois, Google Dorking, Subdomain enumeration). Conduct active reconnaissance with DNS enumeration (DNS Zone Transfer, Bruteforce), host discovery (ping sweeps, ARP scans), port scanning, and banner grabbing to thoroughly map target networks and identify potential entry points.

children.name: Network Scanning & Vulnerability Analysis
children.description: Master Nmap for advanced port scanning, OS detection, service version enumeration, and script usage (NSE scripts). Understand the principles and operation of commercial and open-source vulnerability scanners (Nessus, OpenVAS, Qualys, Tenable.io) for identifying known weaknesses, understanding CVEs, and prioritizing remediation.

children.name: Service Enumeration, Weaknesses & Exploitation
children.description: Enumerate and identify vulnerabilities in common network services: SMB (null sessions, share enumeration, relay attacks), SSH (bruteforce, misconfigurations), FTP (anonymous access, weak creds), SMTP (user enumeration, open relay), SNMP (community strings), DNS, Databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB - weak creds, default configs), and directory services (LDAP).

resources.title: HackTricks Knowledge Base - Network Services Pentesting
Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Exploitation Frameworks & Techniques
children.description: Learn to utilize the Metasploit Framework for exploiting vulnerabilities, generating sophisticated payloads, configuring listeners, and managing sessions (Meterpreter). Understand manual exploitation methods, including basic buffer overflows (stack-based, SEH), format string bugs, and client-side exploits with tools like BeEF (Browser Exploitation Framework).

children.name: Linux Privilege Escalation
children.description: Master techniques to elevate privileges on Linux systems, including kernel exploits, SUID/SGID binaries abuse, cron jobs, environment variables, misconfigured services, path vulnerabilities, weak file permissions, unpatched software, and exploiting containers/namespaces.

children.name: Windows Privilege Escalation
children.description: Learn to escalate privileges on Windows systems through kernel exploits, service misconfigurations (unquoted service paths, weak service permissions), registry abuses, cached credentials, DLL hijacking, UAC bypasses, exploiting vulnerable drivers, and understanding token impersonation.

children.name: Active Directory Penetration Testing
children.description: Focus on attacking Active Directory environments. Learn enumeration techniques (BloodHound, ADRecon), Kerberoasting, AS-REP Roasting, Pass-the-Hash/Ticket, Golden/Silver Ticket attacks, GPO abuses, and common misconfigurations leading to domain compromise using tools like Impacket, Mimikatz, and PowerView.

resources.title: Hack The Box - Active Directory Module
Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Post-Exploitation, Persistence & Lateral Movement
children.description: Understand how to maintain access (backdoors, persistent implants, scheduled tasks, registry modifications), exfiltrate data securely, perform deeper reconnaissance on compromised hosts, and move laterally within a network using pivoting, tunneling (SSH, Chisel, Iodine), RDP, PsExec, and WMI techniques. Learn anti-forensics basics.

children.name: Wireless Network Penetration Testing
children.description: Explore techniques for auditing and exploiting wireless networks, including WEP/WPA/WPA2/WPA3 cracking, Evil Twin attacks, rogue access points, client deauthentication, and packet injection attacks using tools like Aircrack-ng suite, Kismet, and bettercap. Understand enterprise wireless security (802.1X).

children.name: Cloud Security Assessment Fundamentals (AWS, Azure, GCP)
children.description: Gain a foundational understanding of common cloud service provider (AWS, Azure, GCP) security models, shared responsibility, and common services. Learn about typical misconfigurations and attack vectors in S3 buckets, IAM roles, virtual networks, compute instances, serverless functions, and container services. Familiarize with cloud-specific tools like Pacu, CloudGoat.

tree.name: Advanced Topics & Professional Practice
tree.description: Refine professional skills in reporting and client communication, delve into specialized areas like social engineering and mobile testing, understand red teaming concepts, and prepare for career advancement including certifications and portfolio building.

resources.title: Penetration Testing: A Hands-On Introduction to Hacking
Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Professional Reporting & Client Communication
children.description: Develop skills in writing clear, concise, and impactful penetration test reports for both technical and executive audiences. Learn to articulate technical findings, provide compelling evidence, assess risk (CVSS, DREAD, industry best practices), recommend practical and prioritized remediations, and present findings effectively during debriefs.

children.name: Social Engineering Techniques
children.description: Understand the psychology behind social engineering attacks and how human factors are exploited. Learn about common tactics such as phishing, vishing, smishing, pretexting, baiting, quid pro quo, and physical security concepts like tailgating, impersonation, and basic lock picking (conceptual understanding for security awareness).

resources.title: Social Engineering: The Art of Human Hacking (Chris Hadnagy)

children.name: Red Teaming & Adversary Simulation Concepts
children.description: Gain an introduction to red teaming principles, understanding adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) using frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK. Learn about evading defensive measures like Antivirus (AV), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) conceptually, and initial access techniques, command and control (C2) frameworks (e.g., Cobalt Strike, Sliver).

resources.title: Red Team Operations: A Practical Guide
Intro to Red Teaming (Hack The Box Academy)

children.name: Mobile Application Penetration Testing (Android & iOS)
children.description: Explore the security models of Android and iOS applications. Learn static (APK/IPA analysis, decompilation) and dynamic analysis techniques, runtime manipulation, reverse engineering basics, and common mobile vulnerabilities (OWASP Mobile Top 10) using tools like MobSF, Frida, Objection, Genymotion, and Burp Suite with proxy configurations for mobile traffic.

resources.title: Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Career Development & Certifications
children.description: Understand popular and industry-recognized penetration testing certifications (OSCP, PNPT, GPEN, eJPTv2, CEH). Learn strategies for building a strong professional portfolio, including CTF write-ups, bug bounty successes, personal projects, and active GitHub contributions. Prepare for interviews, resume optimization, and networking opportunities in the cybersecurity field.

children.name: Capstone Project: Full-Scope Penetration Test Simulation
children.description: Execute a comprehensive, full-scope penetration test on a complex, simulated enterprise environment integrating web applications, network infrastructure, Active Directory, and potentially cloud elements. This involves end-to-end planning, reconnaissance, exploitation, privilege escalation, lateral movement, data exfiltration, and culminates in a professional report and simulated client debrief.

resources.title: Cyber Defend Institute - Red Team Ops Lab
